सम्-प्रदायिन् mfn. bringing about, causing, effecting, VarBṛS.
सम्-प्रदायिन् m. ‘having a tradition’, a holder of any traditional doctrine, a member of a sect (e.g Vaiṣṇavas are sometimes called Śrī-sampradāyins), W.
सम्-प्र-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to point out or indicate fully, appoint, designate, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्रदिष्ट mfn. clearly pointed out, indicated, designated, MBh.; VarBṛS.
known as, called (nom.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ दीप् Caus. -दीपयति, to set fire to, inflame, kindle, MBh.
सम्-प्रदीप्त mfn. blazing or flaming up, shining very brightly, brilliant, ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-प्रदुत (?) m. N. of a man, Buddh.
सम्-प्र-√ दुष् P. -दुष्यति, to become thoroughly bad, deteriorate, MBh.; Suśr.
सम्-प्रदुष्ट mfn. wholly corrupted or polluted, VarBṛS.
सम्-प्रदूषण n. utter deterioration, corruption, Car.

सम्-प्र-√ दृश् (cf. सम्-प्र√ पश्) Pass. -दृश्यते (˚ति), to be clearly seen or observed, appear, MBh.; R.; Hariv. :
Caus. -दर्शयति, to cause to see, show, indicate, declare (आत्मानम् मृत-वत्, ‘to feign one's self dead’), ib. &c.
सम्-प्रदर्शित mfn. (fr. Caus.) clearly shown, exhibited, manifested, declared, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to run away together, run quite off, escape, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्रा√ द्रु (only in pr. p. -प्राद्रवत्, with v.l. -प्र-द्र्˚), to run away together, MBh. ix, 1675.
सम्-प्रद्रुत mfn. run away, escaped, MBh.
सम्-प्र-धान n. (√ 1. धा) consideration, ascertainment, W.

सम्-प्र-√ 1. धाव् to run quite away, hurry off, escape, MBh.;
to hasten towards, be attracted, BhP.
सम्-प्रधारण n. (and f(आ). ) determination, deliberation, deciding on the propriety or impropriety of anything, Bhar.; Daśar.; Sāh.
सम्-˚प्रधारित mfn. fixed or determined upon, deliberated about, MW.
सम्-˚प्रधार्य mfn. to be considered or deliberated about, R.
सम्-प्र-√ धृष् Caus. -धर्षयति, to offer violence to, outrage, insult, violate, hurt, MBh.
सम्-प्र-नृत्त mfn. (√ नृत्) beginning to dance or move about, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ पच् Pass. -पच्यते, to become quite ripe or mature, come to a head (as a boil &c.), Suśr.
सम्-प्रपन्न mfn. gone together towards, entered &c.
one who has recourse to (acc.), MBh.
(ifc.) endowed or filled with, Caurap.
सम्-प्रपद n. pl. standing on tiptoe, Yājñ. iii, 51 (cf. Mn. vi, 21).
सम्-प्र-√ पीड् Caus. -पीडयति, to press well together, Car.
सम्-प्रपीडित mfn. greatly afflicted or harassed, MBh.
सम्-प्रपुष्पित mfn. richly furnished with blossoms or flowers, R.
सम्-प्र-√ पूज् Caus. -पूजयति, to honour greatly, revere, Hariv.

सम्-प्र-√ बाध् Ā. -बाधते, to press or drive back, repel, resist, MBh.;
to oppress, pain, torment, R.

सम्-प्र-√ बुध् Ā. -बुध्यते, to awake i.e. begin to take effect (as a spell or incantation), Cat. :
Caus. -बोधयति, to rouse up, awaken, ŚBr.
सम्-प्रबुद्ध mfn. roused up, awakened, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रबोधित mfn. (fr. Caus.) convinced, persuaded, Hariv.
consulted or deliberated about, ib.
सम्-प्र-भग्न mfn. (√ 1. भञ्ज्) entirely broken, broken up, dispersed, routed (as an army), MBh. : R.
सम्-प्रभव m. coming forth, rising, appearance (only ifc.), VarBṛS.
सम्-प्र-√ भा P. -भाति, to shine forth clearly, be conspicuous, appear, MBh.

सम्-प्र-√ भाष् Ā. -भाषते (ep. also ˚ति), to speak to, accost, address (acc.), MBh.;
to speak, say, proclaim, recite, repeat, ib.; Hariv.
सम्-प्र-भिन्न mfn. (√ भिद्) split quite asunder, split open, cleft (said of an elephant whose temples are cleft during the rutting season; cf. मद), MBh.
सम्-प्र-मत्त mfn. (√ मद्) very excited (said of an elephant in rut), Hariv.
very careless, thoughtless, neglectful, MBh.
very fond of (inf.), ib. viii, 3509 (B. सम्-प्र-वृत्त).

सम्-प्र-√ मथ् (or -मन्थ्) P. -मथति, -मन्थति, or -मथ्नाति (ind.p. -मथ्य, q.v.), to stir about or agitate violently, violate, outrage, oppress, harass, annoy, MBh.;
to tear out (the eyes), R.

सम्-प्र-√ मथ् (or -मन्थ्) P. -मथति, -मन्थति, or -मथ्नाति (ind.p. -मथ्य, q.v.), to stir about or agitate violently, violate, outrage, oppress, harass, annoy, MBh.;
to tear out (the eyes), R.
सम्-प्रमथ्य ind. violently, by force, R.
सम्-प्रमर्दन See सम्-प्र. √ मृद् below.
सम्-प्रमर्दन mfn. crushing down, destroying, ib.
सम्-प्रमाद See अ-स्˚.
सम्-प्रमापण n. (fr. सम् + 2. प्र्˚) killing, slaughter, Yājñ., Sch.
सम्-प्र-मार्ग m. (√ मृज्) purification, Gobh., Sch.
सम्-प्रमुखित mfn. (see प्रमुख) placed at the head, foremost, first, chief, Lalit.

सम्-प्र-√ मुच् P. Ā. -मुञ्चति, ˚ते (ind.p. -मुच्य, q.v.), to loosen entirely, set quite free, deliberate, ŚāṅkhBr. :
Pass. -मुच्यते, to free one's self from, get rid of (abl.), GopBr.
सम्-प्रमुक्ति f. letting loose (cattle), Kāṭh.
सम्-प्रमुच्य ind. having abandoned or quitted, being quite free from (abl.), ŚBr.
सम्-प्र-मुषित mfn. (√ मुष्) carried quite away, abstracted, distracted, L.
सम्-प्रमोष m. carrying off, abstraction, loss (= नाश), BhP.
सम्-प्रमुग्ध mfn. completely confused
सम्-प्रमुग्ध—त्व n. confusion, perturbation, Pat.
सम्-प्रमूढ mfn. utterly bewildered or confused, perplexed, embarrassed, MBh.
सम्-प्रमोह m. utter bewilderment, embarrassment, infatuation, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ मृद् (only ind.p. -मृद्य), to trample or crush to pieces, destroy, MBh.
सम्-प्रमेह m. morbid flow of urine, Car.
सम्-प्र-√ मोक्ष् P. Ā. -मोक्षयति, ˚ते, to make free, clear away (Ā. ‘to clear a way for one's self’), MBh.
सम्-प्रमोद m. excessive joy or delight, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to strive eagerly for, exert one's self about, be intent upon (dat.), Kām.
सम्-प्रयाण n. proceeding together towards, setting out, departure, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-˚प्रयात mfn. gone forth together &c.
proceeding with i.e. making use of, employing (instr.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ याच् Ā. -याचते, to ask for together, solicit, beg, request (two acc.), MBh.
सम्-प्रयास m. great exertion, effort, exhaustion, BhP.
सम्-प्रयुज् mfn. surrounded or encompassed by (comp.), Śiś.
सम्-प्रयुक्त mfn. yoked or joined together, yoked, harnessed &c.
united or connected or furnished or endowed with (instr. or comp.), RPrāt.; MBh. &c.
come into contact or having intercourse with (instr.), Mn. xi, 179
sexually united, MW.
encountering in a hostile manner, MBh.
engaged in or occupied with (comp.), Kām.
concentrated, wholly intent on one object, MBh.
bound to, dependent on (loc.), ib.
urged, impelled, incited, ib.
सम्-प्रयुक्तक mfn. co-operative, L.
सम्-प्रयोक्तव्य mfn. to be used or employed, Sāh.
सम्-˚प्रयोग m. (ifc. f(आ). ) joining together, attaching, fastening, Mṛcch.
conjunction, union, connection, contact with (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), Āpast.; MBh. &c. (cf. MWB. 44)
matrimonial or sexual union with (comp.), MBh.; VarBṛS.
(in astron.) conjunction (of the moon and the lunar mansions), VarBṛS.
mutual proportion, connected series or arrangement, W.
application, employment, Cat.
spell, L.
सम्-˚प्रयोग mfn. = अर्थित, L.
सम्-˚प्रयोगिका f. N. of wk.
साम्प्रयोगिक mfn. (fr. सम्प्रयोग) relating to use or application, Cat.
सम्-˚प्रयोगिन् mfn. addicted to sexual intercourse, wanton = कामुक, L.
= सु-प्रयोग, L.
सम्-प्रयोजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) joined together, connected, Sāh.
produced, brought forward, MBh.
employed, used, MW.
well suited for anything, adapted, suitable, ib.
सम्-˚प्रयोज्य mfn. to be executed or performed, Bhar.
सम्-प्र-√ युध् Ā. -युध्यते, to begin to fight together, commence a war or battle, fight, R.; Hariv.
सम्-प्रयुद्ध mfn. engaged in war, fighting, MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-प्र-√ रुच् Ā. -रोचते to appear very bright or beautiful, appear good or right, please, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ 2. रुध् Pass. -रुध्यते, to be completely debarred from, be deprived of (v.l. सम्-अव-र्˚), Hariv.
सम्-प्र-रुष्ट mfn. (√ रुष्) greatly enraged or irritated, furious, MBh.
सम्-प्रलाप m. talk, chatter, Sāh.
सम्-प्र-√ ली Ā. -लीयते, to be completely dissolved in (loc.), become absorbed, disappear, vanish, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्रलीन mfn. wholly dissolved or melted away, disappeared, vanished, R.
absorbed i.e. contained in (loc.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ लुप् Pass. -लुप्यते, to be violated or injured, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ लुभ् Caus. -लोभयति, to allure or entice away, try to seduce or deceive, MBh.

सम्-प्र-√ वच् P. -वक्ति, to explain or declare together, ŚāṅkhBr.;
to relate at full or comprehensively, declare, communicate, announce, Mn.; MBh. &c.
सम्-प्रोक्त mfn. spoken to, addressed, MBh.
सम्-प्रोक्त See सम्-प्र-√ वच्.
सम्-प्रवदन n. talking together, conversation, W.
सम्-प्रवादन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of causing to sound together or at the same time, ĀpGṛ., Sch.
सम्-प्रवाद m. id., AitĀr.
सम्-प्रवादित n. causing to sound together, Lalit.
सम्-प्रवाह m. continuous stream, uninterrupted continuity, Kād.; BhP.
सम्-प्र-वि-√ चर् Caus. -चारयति, to examine or consider carefully, R.
सम्-प्र-√ विप् Ā. -वेपते, to tremble violently, MBh.
सम्-प्रविलापन n. dissolving, causing to disappear, MBh., Sch.
सम्-प्रविष्ट mfn. entered together or completely, gone into, R.; Kathās. &c.
सम्-प्रवेश m. entering into together, complete entrance, going into (loc. or comp.), KātyŚr.; MBh.; R.
place of entrance, place entered by (gen.), MBh.
सम्-˚प्रवेशित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made or allowed to enter or return (opp. to निर्-वासित, ‘exiled’), Rājat.
सम्-प्र-वि-√ हृ (only ind. -हृत्य), to roam or wander all over (acc.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ 2. वृ Caus. -वारयति, to wait on, entertain, Divyāv.
सम्-प्रवर्तक mfn. (fr. Caus.) setting in motion, promoting, furthering, Kām.
producing, creating (applied to Śiva), MBh.
सम्-˚प्रवर्तन n. moving or hurrying about, Kām.
the act of setting in motion or action, undertaking, MW.
सम्-˚प्रवर्तिन् mfn. putting in order, setting right, Car.
सम्-प्रवृत्त mfn. gone forward, proceeded, set off, BhP.
arisen, existent, present, near at hand, ib.
commenced, begun, MBh.; R.
passed, gone by, W.
setting about anything (inf. dat., or loc.), MBh.
engaged in (loc. or comp.), ib.
सम्-प्रवृत्ति f. (only pl.) coming forth, appearance, occurrence, MBh.

सम्-प्र-√ वृध् Ā. -वर्धते, to grow well up, attain full growth, grow, increase, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -वर्धयति, to cause to grow or increase, R.
सम्-प्रविद्ध mfn. full grown, increased, swelled, enhanced, well advanced, MBh.; VarBṛS.; Kām.
rich in (instr.), MBh.
सम्-प्र-वृष्ट mfn. (√ वृष्) begun to rain, MBh.
सम्-प्र-वृष्ट n. what has been completely rained, a whole rainfall, VarBṛS.
सम्-प्र-√ वे P. Ā. -वयति, ˚ते, to interweave, sew or string together, connect, ŚāṅkhBr.
सम्-प्र-√ वेष्ट् Caus. -वेष्टयति, to wind round, Suśr.
सम्-प्र-व्यथित mfn. (√ व्यथ्) greatly troubled or alarmed, R.
सम्-प्र-शान्त mfn. (√ शम्) ceased, disappeared, MBh.
सम्-प्र-√ शास् P. -शास्ति, (with रज्यम्) to exercise government, bear sway, rule, reign, MBh.
सम्-प्रश्रय m. respectful demeanour, modesty, humbleness, BhP.
सम्-प्रश्रित mfn. modest, humble, well-behaved, MW.
सम्-प्र-√ सञ्ज् Pass. -सज्जते (ep. also ˚ति), to cling to, be attached to or fond of (loc. or instr.), MBh.
सम्-प्रसक्त mfn. devoted to, intent upon, occupied with (अत्र), MBh.
lasting, continuous, permanent, R.

सम्-प्र-√ सद् P. -सीदति, to settle down quietly, be soothed, be kindly disposed or gracious towards (gen.), MBh.; R. &c.:
Caus. -सादयति, to appease, propitiate, ib.
सम्-प्रसत्ति f. = सम्-प्रसाद (in Vedānta), Śaṃk.
सम्-प्रसन्न mfn. soothed, appeased, ChUp.
propitious, favourable, gracious, BhP.
सम्-प्रसा॑द m. perfect quiet (esp. mental repose during deep sleep), ŚBr.; Lalit.
favour, grace, Uttarar.
serenity, Bhaṭṭ. (v.l.)
(in Vedānta) the soul during deep sleep, ChUp.; MBh. &c.
trust, confidence, W.
सम्-˚प्रसादन mfn. (fr. Caus.) calming, sedative, Car.
सम्-प्रसव m. (सम् + 2. प्र्˚) admission, Kull. on Mn. viii, 112 (v.l. प्रति-प्र्˚).
सम्-प्रसह्य ind. thoroughly, by all means, MBh.

सम्-प्र-√ साध् Caus. -साधयति, to accomplish, settle, set right (see below);
to make one's own, acquire, MW.
सम्-प्रसाधन n. accomplishing, arranging, decorating, Car.; Bhpr.
the act of effecting or accomplishing, W.
सम्-˚प्रसाध्य mfn. to be accomplished or set right, Kām.
सम्-प्र-√ सिच् Pass. -सिच्यते, to flow out, issue, Hariv.; Suśr.
सम्-प्र-सिद्ध mfn. (√ 3. सिध्) well prepared, cooked, Suśr.
सम्-प्रसिद्धि f. success, good luck, Divyāv.
सम्-प्र-सुप्त mfn. (√ स्वप्) fallen fast asleep, sleeping, MBh.
closed (not expanded, as a flower), ib.

सम्-प्र-√ 2. सू Ā. -सूते, or -सूयते, to bring forth, beget, generate, Mn.; MBh. :
Pass. सूयते (or ˚ति), to be born, MBh. iii, 12978.
सम्-प्रसूत mfn. brought forth, begot, procreated, MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c.
सम्-˚प्रसूति f. bringing forth together or at the same time, VarBṛS.

सम्-प्र-√ सृ Caus. -सारयति, ˚ते, to stretch or spread out, extend, VS.; TS.; MaitrS.; Hcat.;
to draw asunder, ĀpŚr.
सम्-प्रसार m. one through whom all goes on well, BrahmUp.
सम्-˚प्रसारण n. drawing asunder, Anup.
(in gram.) the mutual interchange of the vowels इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ, and their corresponding semivowels य्, व्, र्, ल्, Pāṇ. i, 1, 45 &c.
सम्-प्र-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to approach or enter in a creeping way, ŚBr.
सम्-प्रसर्पण n. moving along, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-प्रस्तार m. = प्र-स्तोतृ, Hariv. (Nīlak.)
सम्-प्र-स्तुत mfn. (√ स्तु) ready to, prepared for (inf.), Rājat.
सम्-प्रथान n. the act of setting out together, setting out on a journey, departure, W.
सम्-प्रस्थित mfn. set out on a journey, departed, MBh.; R. &c.
advancing towards Buddha hood (?), Divyāv.
सम्-प्र-√ स्पृश् P. -स्पृशति, to touch or sprinkle with water, wash, bathe, MW.

सम्-प्र-√ स्रु P. -स्रवति, to flow forth together, issue from (abl.), Up.; R. :
Caus. स्रावयति, to cause to run together, mix, mingle, TBr.

सम्-प्र-√ हस् P. -हसति, to laugh together, break into a laugh, MBh.; R.; BhP. :
Caus. -हासयति, to make sport of, deride, Vas.
सम्-प्रहास m. laughing at, loud laughter, Bhaṭṭ.
mockery, derision, R.
सम्-प्र-√ 3. हा P. -जहाति, to leave, abandon, MBh.; R.
सम्-प्र-हित mfn. (√ हि) thrown, hurled, MBh.
सम्-प्रहार m. mutual striking or wounding, war, battle, fighting with (acc. or instr. with or without सह; with मदीय, ‘fighting with me’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a stroke, blow, R.
going, motion, gait, Vas.
सम्-˚प्रहारि Uṇ. iv, 124, Sch.
सम्-˚प्रहारिन् mfn. fighting together, combating, R.

सम्-प्र-√ हृष् P. Ā. -हृष्यति, ˚ते., to rejoice greatly, be exceedingly glad, thrill with pleasure, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -हर्षयति, to rejoice, make glad, comfort, ŚāṅkhBr.; MBh. &c.
सम्-प्रहर्ष m. great joy, thrill of delight, MBh.; R.
सम्-˚प्रहर्षण mfn. exciting sexually, Car.
सम्-˚प्रहर्षणा f. impelling, encouragement, Jātakam.
सम्-˚प्रहर्षित mfn. (fr. Caus.) much pleased, thrilled with delight, MBh.
सम्-˚प्रहर्षिन् mfn. rejoicing greatly, delighted, very glad, R.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट mfn. excessively rejoiced, rejoicing, joyful, MBh.; R. &c.
erect, bristling (or ‘standing on end’, as the hair of the body), thrilling, ib.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट—तनूरुह mfn. having the hairs of the body bristling with delight, MBh.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट—मनस् mfn. overjoyed in heart, R.
सम्-प्रहृष्ट—मुख mfn. having the face radiant with joy, MBh.
सम्-प्रान्त m. ultimate or absolute end, KāśīKh.
सम्-प्राप्त mfn. well reached or attained, obtained, gained &c.
one who has reached or attained, arrived at, met with, fallen into (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(ifc.) extending to, Suśr.
come, become, appeared, arrived (as a period of time), Mn.; MBh. &c.
sprung or descended from (-तस्), Mn. ix, 141
सम्-प्राप्त—यौवन mfn. one who has fully attained youth or manhood, come of age, MBh.
सम्-प्राप्त—विद्य mfn. one who has acquired all knowledge, ib.
सम्-˚प्राप्तव्य mfn. to be got or obtained, MBh.
सम्-˚प्राप्ति f. arrival at (comp.), MBh.; R.
rise, appearance, Car.; Sāh.
attainment, gain, acquisition, MBh.; R. &c.
सम्-˚प्राप्ति—द्वादशी f. N. of a partic. twelfth day, Cat.
सम्-˚प्राप्य mfn. to be fully attained to, attainable, obtainable, MW.
सम्-प्रेप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to attain, striving after (acc.), MBh.
wishing to get at, waylaying, ib.
सम्-प्रेप्सु See सम्-प्राप्, col. 1.
सम्-प्रार्थ् (-प्र-√ अर्थ्) P. -प्रार्थयति, to ask for earnestly, request, entreat, MBh.; R.
सम्-प्रार्थित mfn. asked for, begged, requested, MBh.
सम्-प्राव् (-प्र-अव्) P. -प्र॑वति, to assist together, aid, help, AV.
सम्-प्राश् (-प्र- √ 2. अश्) P. -प्राश्नाति, to eat, enjoy, Hcat.

सम्-√ प्री Ā. -प्रीयते, to be completely satisfied or contented, be greatly pleased with, delight in (loc. or abl.), MBh.; R. &c.:
Caus. -प्रीणयति, to make completely happy or pleased, Pur.; Hcat.
स॑म्-प्रिय mfn. mutually dear, being on friendly terms with (instr.), VS.; TS.; GṛS.
very dear or beloved, MW.
स॑म्-प्रिय n. contentment, satisfaction, R.
स॑म्-प्रिया (आ), f. N. of the wife of Vidūratha (or Vidūra), MBh.
सम्-प्रिय—ता f. dearness, the being very dear or dearer than (abl.), Kir.
सम्-प्रीणन n. (fr. Caus.) gladdening, delighting, BhP.
सम्-˚प्रीणित mfn. made completely happy, thoroughly satisfied, well pleased, MārkP.
सम्-प्रीत mfn. completely satisfied or pleased, delighted, MBh.
सम्-प्रीत—मानस mfn. delighted in mind, ib.
सम्-˚प्रीति f. complete satisfaction, joy, delight in (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
attachment, affection, good will, friendship with (instr. with or without सह), love for (loc. or gen.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
सम्-˚प्रीति—मत् mfn. satisfied, pleased, delighted, MBh.
सम्-प्रे (-प्र- √ 5. इ) P. -प्रैति to go forth together, flow together, RV.; AV.

सम्-प्रेक्ष् (-प्र-√ ईक्ष्), to look well at, observe carefully, become aware of, perceive, MBh.; Kāv. &c.;
to consider well, reflect on, examine, Mn.; MBh. &c.
सम्-प्रेक्षक mfn. looking well at, a spectator, beholder, Hariv.
सम्-˚प्रेक्षण n. the act of looking well at, beholding, seeing, W.
deliberating about, considering, investigating, ib.
सम्-˚प्रेक्षित mfn. well looked at or seen, beheld, ib.
considered, investigated, ib.
सम्-प्रे॑द्ध (-प्र + इद्ध) mfn. kindled, lighted, AV.

सम्-प्रेर् (-प्र-√ ईर्) Ā. -प्रेर्ते, to come forth together, rise together, RV.; TS. :
Caus. -प्रेरयति, to drive or push forwards, Pañcat.
सम्-प्रेर्ण mfn. risen up together, MW.
सम्-प्रेष m. = सम्-प्रैष, L.
सम्-˚प्रेषण n. the act of sending forth together, sending away, despatching, Mn.; MBh. &c.
dismissal, R.
सम्-˚प्रेषणी f. N. of a funeral ceremony (performed on the twelfth day after death), L.
सम्-˚प्रेषित mfn. sent forth, despatched, ordered, MBh.
summoned, invited, ĀśvŚr.
सम्-प्रैष॑ m. summons, invitation, direction (to an officiating priest), ŚBr.; ŚrS.
dismissing, sending away, W.
सम्-प्रोक्ष् (-प्र-√ उक्ष्) P. Ā. -प्रोक्षति, ˚ते, to sprinkle well over (Ā. ‘one's self’), consecrate by sprinkling, Kauś.; Yājñ.
सम्-प्रोक्षण n. the act of sprinkling well over, consecration (of a temple &c.), Cat.
सम्-प्रोक्षणी f. consecrated water, Kauś.
सम्-प्रोक्षण—क्रम m. N. of wk.
सम्-प्रोक्षण—विधि m. N. of wk.
सम्-प्रोक्षण—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
सम्-˚प्रोक्षित mfn. well sprinkled or wetted (esp. with holy water), consecrated, Kauś.
सम्-प्रोर्णु (-प्र-√ ऊर्णु) P. Ā. -प्रार्णोति, or ˚णौति, -प्रोर्णुते, to cover all over, cover completely, RV.; ŚBr.
सम्-प्लव m. flowing together, meeting or swelling (of waters), flood, deluge, R.; Hariv.; BhP. a dense mass, heap, multitude, Mn.; MBh. &c.
conglomeration, taking a form or shape, rise, origin, BhP.
noise, tumult (esp. of battle), Hariv.; R.
submersion by water, destruction, ruin, Yājñ.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
end, close of (comp.), BhP.
सम्-प्लुत mfn. flowed or streamed together, met, MBh.
one who has bathed in (comp.), BhP.
flooded over, overspread, covered or filled with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; BhP.
सम्-प्लु˚तोदक mfn. flooded with water, Bhag.
सम्-√ प्सा (only ind.p. -प्साय), to chew thoroughly, bite in pieces, ŚBr.
साम्पन्निक mfn. (fr. सम्-पन्न) one who lives luxuriously, Car.
साम्पादिक mfn. efficacious, Śaṃk.
साम्परायण m. (fr. prec.) one who ushers a person into another world (said of Death), IndSt.
साम्परायणक m. (fr. prec.) g. अरीहणादि.

साम्परायिक mf(आ or ई)n. (g. संतापादि) relating to the future or to the passage into another world, future (with फल n. ‘reward in the next world’; ˚कं-√ कृ, ‘to prepare for death’ or ‘to perform funeral ceremonies for [gen.]’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
relating to or prepared for battle, martial, warlike, ib.
salutary or helpful in time of need, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
साम्परायिक m. (with or scil. रथ) a war-chariot, L.
साम्परायिक (अम्), n. war, battle, L.
साम्परायिक—कल्प m. military form, strategic array, Mn. vii, 185.
साम्पीक m. N. of a poet, Cat.
साम्प्रत mfn. (fr. सम्-प्रति) seasonable, fit, proper, correct (cf. अ-स्˚), Lāṭy.; Sarvad.
belonging to the present time, present (not past or future) comp.
साम्प्रतम् (अम्), ind. fitly, properly, MBh.
presently, now, ib.; &c.
साम्प्रत—काल m. the present time, Sāṃkhyak.
साम्प्रताधिप m. a present or reigning sovereign, MārkP.
साम्प्रतिक mf(ई)n. suitable, fit, proper, Uttarar.
present (not future), Kull.
साम्प्रदानिक mfn. (fr. सम्प्रदान) g. विनयादि.
साम्प्रदायिक mfn. (fr. सम्-प्रदाय) based on tradition, traditional (cf. अ-स्˚), Baudh.; Jaim.
standing upon or following tradition, RāmatUp.
साम्प्रयोगिकाधिकरण n. N. of a Kāma-śāstra.
साम्प्रश्निक mfn. (fr. सम्प्रश्न) g. छेदादि.
साम्प्रियक mfn. (fr. सम्-प्रिय) inhabited by people who are dear to one another g. राजन्यादि.
